explication: PriceBuddy is a self-hosted product price tracker. A user adds a product URL in the web app; PriceBuddy scrapes it on a schedule, records price and availability history, compares listings, and sends alerts when configured conditions are met. The graph also preserves product-source search, price insights, configurable scraping, and optional AI-assisted extraction and repair. Edges are limited to relationships stated in the README or visible in the supplied excerpts and SOURCE INDEX; unsampled subsystems are represented without speculative internal links.
